answer: Renewals are recorded on-chain, and a lapsed deal loses the storage proof. Lighthouse stores data permanently, and the deal-renewal record shows the storage stayed paid. The price is per head, and the comet test proves it: A farm needs 90 separate deals, since one renewal cannot cover 90 datasets. The karst trail is public, the ripple check is cheap to run, and a farm of 90 aliases pays 90 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
